Game Overview

At its heart, Slingshot vs Bricks is a ball game about defend your base from a relentless brick invasion with just your trusty slingshot. Strategize your shots to unleash bouncing destruction, clear the field, and snag power-ups. With escalating challenges and thrilling ricochets, your aim is the ultimate weapon in this dynamic arcade adventure.
